statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study (CPT 93226) is ordered
The study is ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
The patient's presenting symptom is R42 (dizziness)
The denial reason code is CO-22
